name: Plex
desc: Movies and shows from your Plex server

changes.summary: Only your own Plex account can control the box, and no freezes around playback
points: Casting and the remote in the Plex app only work from your account or your Plex Home
A slow server no longer freezes the box before and after a video
Intro and credits markers are fetched without stopping the keys
A server you cast from is no longer saved in the server list
